summary: The conductor's first run, in the editor's session: read the newsroom, the PHP story site, sgit.ai's team and repositories guidance, coding and nfrs; mapped both repositories; built the admin section (v0.5.14), Commit-FS-lite as the protocol with tools/notes.py and the notes page (v0.5.15), the roster of every session from the editor's screenshot (v0.5.18); the CLI's AGENTS.md (cbd466d, ef92296). Collided three times with build@ and pbp@ releasing within minutes; renumbered each time. Findings: releases collide for want of a release script; comms.html was hand-edited by two agents before it was generated from rows; no commit before 23:42 carries an Agent: line; the CLI has no reality file; notes are unsigned claims. Each is a brief.
